info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Status Inquiry API
info.description: The Payment Status Inquiry API enables users to retrieve real-time information on payment initiation requests. This endpoint allows businesses to check the status of payments that have been initiated, helping to ensure transparency and facilitate better cash flow management. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and payment service providers that need to monitor transaction progress. By leveraging this API, users can streamline their operations and enhance their customer service related to payment processing.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific payment initiation identified by its unique ID. This endpoint allows developers to access relevant data related to the payment, enabling effective tracking and management of payment processes.
